<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2013/05/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>WitSeal.AgentFramework</id>
    <version>0.1.0</version>
    <authors>WitSeal Maintainers</authors>
    <license type="expression">Apache-2.0</license>
    <licenseUrl>https://licenses.nuget.org/Apache-2.0</licenseUrl>
    <readme>README.md</readme>
    <projectUrl>https://github.com/WitSeal/witseal-dotnet</projectUrl>
    <description>Witnessed execution for Microsoft Agent Framework: a WitSeal-authored tool and a function-invocation middleware that route an agent's command execution through the WitSeal runtime, producing an independently verifiable execution receipt for every command the agent runs.</description>
    <tags>witseal agent ai microsoft-agent-framework witness receipt governance audit</tags>
    <repository type="git" url="https://github.com/WitSeal/witseal-dotnet" commit="5391b335a95019d502e8221c0e5c199d52bea7c5" />
    <dependencies>
      <group targetFramework="net8.0">
        <dependency id="Microsoft.Agents.AI" version="1.9.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
    </dependencies>
  </metadata>
</package>
